notes.note: Reviewed the additional clock-jump regression against the create owner and bounded live-owner test. Retained unresolved input proof now conflicts before waiting on an owner even past the seven-day wall-clock bound; the conflicting effect is not invoked. Expired original keys still retain indeterminate Session references, deliberate separate new keys remain permitted, and live-owner expiry protection remains intact. This corrects the implementation to the documented contract; no prose change is needed.
